# Hermes Integration

Hermes consumes the root Agent Plugins v1 manifest and shared skills. Enable the staged package explicitly through the host's plugin flow, then use `skills_list` to discover each full qualified name and `skill_view` to load it. Hermes generates an `agent-plugin-<slug>-<hash>` namespace; do not assume `maestria:<skill>`.

Load global-rules and orchestrator by their discovered names. Apply portable role guidance within the tools and delegation controls the host exposes. Portable skills do not supply a trust policy, permissions, or sandbox. This bundle includes no Python adapter, native Hermes hooks, or MCP declaration.

See [Hermes portable package support](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/developer-guide/plugins#portable-agent-plugins-v1-packages).

Live host loading is unverified. Package and sync checks validate the shipped files, not runtime discovery or enforcement.
